More about my work

I'm a senior software engineer in Milwaukee, and I work on browser performance and observability. I write TypeScript and Go. I'm looking for my next role in browser engineering or web performance, Denver preferred.

Recent

  • The OpenTelemetry Browser SDK can join the server trace on page load using context from HTML meta tags. I also added the B3 example to the README.
  • The OpenTelemetry Ecosystem Explorer now shows events on Java agent instrumentation pages.
  • My Faro exporter fix in the OpenTelemetry Collector contrib repo merged October 16, 2026 and shipped in v0.164.0. The Faro translator fuzz tests and fix that returns the meta encoding error have merged too.
  • More Go work includes mdatagen README markers in the Collector, Alloy CORS headers for the Faro receiver and goroutine stack traces in support bundles, and list_alerts truncation in the Prometheus MCP server. The k6 navigation check merged. My Collector fix to preserve the connection's remote address is approved.
  • My work in Grafana Faro covers hard page load navigations (#2359), custom web vitals labels (#2361), custom text masking for session replay (#2362), and tracing setup for the OpenTelemetry SDK 3.0 upgrade (#2358, #2363, #2364).
  • Safari: the browser SDK wouldn't start on Safari 17 because of URL.parse. #447 fixed it, and I wrote up why below.
  • My section on computing INP merged into the W3C Event Timing spec. My layout-instability change links to the CLS session-window explanation. Google's web-vitals has merged eight of my pull requests.
  • Client-side semantic conventions v0.1.0-dev, the first dev release of the browser and mobile registry, came out October 27, 2026. It has #33 in it, which moved enduser.id and enduser.pseudo.id over from core.
  • In OpenTelemetry JS, #7262 fixed B3 trace ID length validation, and #7253 documented that API 1.10.0 needs SDK 3.x.
  • OpenTelemetry JS #7153 removed the pagehide listener from the trace and log SDKs, and shipped in 3.0.0.
  • OpenTelemetry demo #3966 replaced the Python recommendation service with Java on Spring Boot 4 and merged October 13, 2026. On November 3 #4232 gave its catalog calls a deadline. The companion Helm chart change is still open.

Judging and certification

  • Judge at HackOHI/O 2026, The Ohio State University's hackathon. I scored seven student teams on October 25, 2026.
  • I judged Kendor Build Day in November 2026. I'm also a judge for DSH Hacks V2, November 15 to 22, 2026.
  • Virtual judge for Diamond Challenge 2027.
  • Scorer for the San Mateo County STEM Fair, March 3 to 12, 2027.
  • Judge for the 2027 American Business Awards.
  • OpenTelemetry Certified Associate, passed October 30, 2026.

Writing

  • The pagehide listener that never ran, November 7, 2026.
  • What broke when I moved Grafana Faro to OpenTelemetry JS 3.0, November 3, 2026.
  • Why your INP can fall after one more click, November 2, 2026.
  • How one Desk Studio job gets from roughs to sign-off, October 20, 2026.
  • Why the OpenTelemetry browser SDK wouldn't start on Safari 17, October 2, 2026.
  • Preprint: The judge cannot see the margin, a paired ablation study, posted on Zenodo October 29, 2026.

Projects

  • Desk Studio runs inside the coding agent you already use. I released v1.1.1 on GitHub on November 18.
  • System Designer: a free browser game for practicing system design. Pick a real problem, draw the system, then watch a full day of traffic hit it.
  • adityareddy.dev is a small 3D browser game about one working day. The resume is in the phone.
  • react-inp-blame: connects slow browser interactions to React renders and handlers when it can identify them.
  • otel-js-upgrade: reviewable migration diffs for OpenTelemetry JavaScript. It applies supported SDK 2.12 changes and previews SDK 3 migrations.
  • otel-zoneless-context: browser context manager without zone.js.
  • otel-cluster-metrics: cumulative OpenTelemetry metrics from Node cluster workers through one Prometheus endpoint, 0.1.0 is on npm.

Upstream

Member of the OpenTelemetry GitHub org and an OpenTelemetry Browser approver.

I contribute to OpenTelemetry's browser SDK, client-side semantic conventions, GenAI semantic conventions, Collector, JavaScript SDK, ecosystem explorer, demo, Helm charts and docs. Also Grafana Alloy, k6 and Faro, the Prometheus MCP server, and frontend load time in GitLab.

I have seven merged pull requests in PostHog's JavaScript SDK. My datastore reporting docs change merged in New Relic's Node.js agent, and my fix for browser test fixtures on Windows merged in k6.
